name: trustmate
description: Operate a TrustMate certificate authority: issue, preview, inspect and revoke certificates, read CRLs and request RFC 3161 timestamps

server.title: TrustMate server URL
server.description: Base URL of the TrustMate REST API, e.g. https://ca.example.com:8080

client_cert.title: Client certificate
client_cert.description: PEM client certificate issued by this CA. Use a manager-role certificate unless admin tools are needed

client_key.title: Client private key
client_key.description: PEM private key for the client certificate. Only trustmate-mcp reads it; it never enters the conversation

server_ca.title: Server CA bundle
server_ca.description: PEM bundle to verify the server, usually the TrustMate root CA (root.pem)

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where generated keys, issued certificates and timestamp tokens are written

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Expose only tools that neither change server state nor write files. Turn off to allow issuing, revoking and timestamping
